ios.notes:
Choose your own playlist cover, signing in works again, and a smoother Eclipse skip.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.5

New
- Choose your own playlist cover: open a playlist's menu and pick "Choose cover…" to use any photo. "Change cover…" and "Remove cover" are there once it has one. Friends who can see the playlist see the cover too.

Fixed
- Signing in works again. On 7.2.3, signing in failed with "Cannot read property 'removeItem' of undefined", and you could be signed out when your session renewed.
- The Eclipse skip animation passes smoothly again on the 3D cover.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.3...ios-v7.2.5

windows.notes:
Press Ctrl+F anywhere to search your library and run quick actions, and download all your Liked Songs to listen offline.

Duotone for Windows 7.1.0

New
- Command palette (Ctrl+F): opens over everything to search your songs, artists and playlists as you type, jump to recent searches, run quick actions or set a sleep timer. Choose "See all results" for server search.
- Download Liked Songs for offline listening, and see how many songs are saved on your PC, the disk space used and "Remove all downloads" in Settings › Windows.

Fixed
- Lyrics with per-word timing no longer show raw timing tags in the text.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.0.7...win-v7.1.0

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
